outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry dot/pseudocolor plots showing individual cell events with gating; these are scatter-type plots where individual data points (cells) are inherently displayed, not summary bar charts of averages.
Flow cytometry scatter plots displaying individual cell events during gating; not an averaged summary plot requiring overlay of individual points.
Flow cytometry dot plots showing individual cells in the gating strategy; each dot is already an individual data point, so no additional overlay is needed.
Color-coded overlay scatter plots of individual cells (MBC, GC, naive populations); individual events are directly plotted, not a bar/mean summary.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots showing individual cell events; not a bar chart or other summary statistic requiring individual point overlay.
